question: Which country hosted the 2023 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2023 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup was hosted the 15th edition of the Men's FIH Hockey World Cup.

 
 
• It was held from 13th January to 29th January 2023 at the Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar and Rourkela in India.
 
• The quadrennial world championship for men's national field hockey teams is organized by the International Hockey Federation.
 
• The sixteen national teams were required to register a playing squad of eighteen players and two reserve players.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Hockey Federation commonly known by the acronym FIH.

 
 
• Its headquarter is in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• Mohammad Tayyab Ikram of Macau was elected as the new president of the International Hockey Federation.
